technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with long-term bullish structure conflict with bearish price action, weak momentum, and lack of confirmation—high risk of continued downside before reversal.

fundamental.summary: KMI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 35 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 small buy, 1 sale, 1 medium buy 118 days old) and absent news sentiment provide insufficient conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (383.5), flat yield curve, FOMC event today, and elevated credit stress create a severely adverse macro backdrop for KMI despite 35-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) + long-term EMA bullish alignment + contrarian fear sentiment (11/100) create textbook reversal setup with defined support at 14.2909.
debate.key_bear_argument: Bearish price action (below EMA 9/21, three black crows, negative CMF/OBV), zero momentum confirmation, FOMC event today, VIX crisis (383.5), and high earnings risk in 35 days overwhelm oversold technicals in hostile macro environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9) and long-term EMA bullish structure present textbook reversal setup at support. However, bearish price action, zero momentum confirmation, and FOMC event today create unacceptable timing risk.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (383.5) and FOMC event today will likely drive continued volatility; earnings in 35 days add binary risk with no fundamental catalyst to justify entry into hostile macro backdrop.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technicals show oversold reversal setup, but risk and debate agents strongly favor bear case; macro environment overrides technical setup
decision.portfolio_note: Existing KMI position + 1 other Energy holding creates sector concentration; skip avoids adding to already-exposed portfolio in crisis VIX environment.
